{{Quote|Is there any other information you need?|The droid to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
During the [[Old Sith Wars]], a '''droid''' was present on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was used by the [[Garang municipal authorities|local authorities]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an [[Analysis droid/Legends|information droid]]. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was taken by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] to the scene of [[Calder Nettic]]'s [[Death/Legends|murder]]. The droid assisted Bolook and an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in solving the murder.

==Biography==
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was in service on the<ref name="KOTOR" /> remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was used by the [[Garang municipal authorities|municipal authorities]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the Republic as an [[Analysis droid/Legends|information droid]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

[[File:CalderNetticCrimeScene.png|thumb|left|200x|The scene of Nettic's death]]
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Both ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' place the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which includes the murder investigation, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> several weeks<ref name="Weeks">The game establishes that [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] had been [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before gaining access to the [[Ancient Grove (Dantooine)|Ancient Grove]], where the murder took place. Since [[Calder Nettic|Nettic]] had been murdered only [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] prior, the murder must have taken place weeks after Revan's arrival.</ref> after the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of the Outer Rim [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] at the hands of the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] named [[Calder Nettic]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] in an Ancient Grove on the planet. The [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|council]] of the nearby [[Jedi Enclave]] sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] to the scene. To assist with the case, Bolook brought an information droid, and the two examined the body and obtained blood samples and evidence for analysis. The evidence was sent to Dantooine's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Garang]]. Bolook began investigating the murder and held two suspects, [[Handon Guld]] and [[Rickard Lusoff]], at the scene for questioning.<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
[[File:InvestigationDantooine.png|thumb|right|200x|The droid assists in the investigation.]]
Several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who had [[Amnesia/Legends|lost his memories]] and was [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], passed through the grove during his final [[Initiate Trials/Legends|initiate trial]]. Bolook saw a chance to give Revan experience, and stopped him to ask for assistance with the case. Revan agreed to help and the two began investigating. The droid connected to the [[Garang archives|archives]] in the capital and the [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] at the enclave in order to assist. It was able to retrieve information on [[Blood/Legends|blood]] samples, [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]], police reports, and business transactions and would relay the information to Revan when asked.<ref name="KOTOR" />

After examining the evidence and interviewing each suspect, Revan came to the unorthodox conclusion that both men were guilty. Revan had discovered that Nettic had an affair with [[Handon Guld's wife|Guld's wife]], and cheated Lusoff in a business deal. Thus, they both had motive to commit the crime. After noticing that Guld was bleeding from his side, Bolook weighed in. He believed that Guld had confronted Nettic and murdered him, while Lusoff, mistaking Guld for Nettic, fired from the bushes and hit Guld in the side. With this, Bolook formally arrested the two men and escorted them to the [[Jedi Enclave holding facilities|Enclave's holding facilities]] to await trial. The droid went with Bolook and left the scene, while Revan continued his trial.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Characteristics==
The droid had reflective metal plating and crude metal [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. It also possessed two [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] capable of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. It was capable of conversing with Bolook in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], prior to Revan's arrival on the scene.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The droid was subservient, exhibiting no clear personality, and responding promptly when asked for information. It was capable of remotely accessing police reports, lab results, and business transactions via archives in both Garang and the Enclave.<ref name="KOTOR" />
